CustomField.description: Widget-wide button sizing so buttons stay consistent. Blank = size to fit the label. Each value is a CSS class defined in ustWidgetButtons.css and allowlisted in ustWidgetButtons.js; to add a size, add a picklist value (API name = class), list it in the JS allowlist, and add its rule. Separate from Content_CSS_Class__c so a panel style and a button size can be combined.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Optional. Leave blank to size buttons to their label.
CustomField.label: Button Size
